title.narrative: Assurer l’accès des enfants affectés par la crise du Soudan (retournés, réfugiés et enfants des communautés hôtes) aux services de protection dans la Vakaga.

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to reinforce protection from violence, abuse and exploitation for children among returnees from Sudan, internally displaced people and host communities in the northeast of the Central African Republic. This UNICEF project provides protection services to 10,000 children in child-friendly spaces, provides specialized protection assistance - such as family reunification or case management - to 100 children, supports 369 child survivors of rape and other sexual violence, among other activities. The project provides child protection assistance to 10,000 people, including 9,500 children of whom 144 are children with disabilities. Some 25,000 people are reached via radio broadcasts.
